verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks for email delivery or engagement events (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes), and no signed payload. The closest items are polling post-send statistics through the Marketing Emails API and post-send workflows, which are adjacent features and do not count as webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe webhooks to delivery and engagement events — sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes — with a documented, signed payload
